clips.title: The story
paras: Myzrael speaks through the keystone, declaring herself free but in hiding from her captors, and tells you to speak with Zaruk in Hammerfall, who knows how she can be summoned.

Myzrael cries out that she is free. For now she must gather her strength out of sight of her captors, because if they faced her today they would overpower and imprison her again. In time, she vows, she will confront the giants who held her, and they will regret keeping her.

Myzrael calls you a noble ally and says she will want your aid again in time. When she is ready, she will have you summon her to the surface. For now she sends you to Zaruk in Hammerfall, who knows how it can be done.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Free! I AM FREE! I am free to gather strength, hidden from my captors. For if they faced me now they would surely overpower and again imprison me.
But in time I will confront the giants, and they will regret their wardship of me!
You are a noble ally, friend. I will need your help again in time. When I am ready, I will need you to summon me to the surface
Speak with Zaruk in Hammerfall. He knows how I can be summoned.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Welcome, adventurer. The Lady has informed me of your coming, and if we are to bring her back to the surface then we have much to discuss...
